candidates.title: F-35 fighter jets, 200+ airmen arrive as US participates in India's Tarang Shakti air exercise
candidates.excerpt: Six American F-35 fighter jets and over 200 US airmen arrived in Jodhpur to participate in Exercise Tarang Shakti. This exercise features the participation of more than 40 countries and strengthens international cooperation in military operations. US Ambassador Sergio Gor and Indian officials observed a joint demonstration by Indian and US Army personnel. The exercise emphasizes deepening bilateral training and trust among participating nations.

'Will never bow our head': Iran embassy invokes Baahubali to echo Pezeshkian's defiant UN speech
candidates.excerpt: Highlighting the parallels between resilience and heroism, the Iranian Embassy in Hyderabad unveiled a video featuring President Masoud Pezeshkian's UNGA address likened to the epic tale of Baahubali. The embassy conveyed Iran's steadfastness against external pressures, as exemplified in Dr. Pezeshkian's rejection of U.S. sanctions. He asserted Iran's commitment to dialogue while maintaining a robust defense posture, amidst escalating U.S.-Iran tensions.

candidates.title: 'Highest Numbers Of Victims After Americans Were Indians': PM Modi On 9/11
candidates.excerpt: Speaking in his monthly 'Mann Ki Baat' programme, PM Modi said this year marked 25 years since the 9/11 attacks and recalled his visit to New York after becoming Prime Minister in 2014, when he paid homage to the victims.
